observations.behavior: Adds a subscription and selector to reload the feed when the stored 'only my scanners' choice changes, while also adding a new date-window option and a shared scanner-label utility.
observations.posthog_connection: This subscription reloads the feed when the user's stored preference for viewing only their own scanners changes, while also accounting for the loading state of the scanner list. This could help maintain feed relevance and avoid stale or empty results when the user's ownership status changes.
